plugin.darts.title: Darts
plugin.darts.boardAimAria: Dartboard. Press to stop the aiming line
plugin.darts.stopY: Stop the horizontal line and throw
plugin.darts.help1: Press Throw and a vertical line sweeps left and right across the board.
plugin.darts.help2: Press again to stop it; a horizontal line then sweeps up and down.
plugin.darts.help3: Press again to stop that one too, and the dart flies to where the two lines cross.
plugin.darts.helpKeys: You can also press the board, Space or Enter.
plugin.darts.waitingNext: Waiting for the next game. When this one ends, the button for the next game appears here.
plugin.darts.startHint: Press to start. This window then shows whose turn it is and the scores.
plugin.darts.rule: 1 player: Count-Up (3 rounds x 3 darts). 2-4 players: 301 (finish exactly on 0, going below is a bust, 8 rounds). Bull is 50.
plugin.darts.howtoBody: Stand on one of the spots in front of the dart machine to play. The game window appears once you are standing there.
plugin.darts.err.notStanding: Stand on a spot at this machine first.
plugin.darts.err.busy: This machine is in a game. Please wait until it ends.
